# ELAPACK

> Custom luxury packaging manufacturer founded in 2018, own factory in Wuxi, Jiangsu, China with three production lines. Designs and produces custom boxes, pouches, bags, and complete packaging sets for brands in Europe and North America — jewelry, eyewear, beauty, fragrance, hair, fashion, gift, and storage-bag uses. Packaging is specified around any product, not jewelry only. ISO 9001 certified (production and sales of paper and textile packaging products). (certificate available on request)

Key facts for buyers:

- Minimum order quantity: 200 pieces per product or component
- Complete sets: box + pouch + card / cloth / ribbon in one order, same colour and branding, MOQ 200 per component
- Lightweight structures: available; weight and freight savings confirmed by sample, not assumed from a guide
- Production lead time: 15–20 days for 200–20,000 units; 30–35 days for 20,000–50,000 units (counted from sample approval and payment receipt)
- Samples: stock samples free (+USD 25 shipping); custom samples USD 30 (+USD 25 shipping), built in 3–5 days — a full custom sample round lands in about two weeks at roughly USD 55 all-in
- Payment: T/T (bank transfer) or PayPal
- Contact: tina@elapack.com | WhatsApp +86 186 2635 2096

- [Custom Christmas packaging](https://elapack.com/custom-christmas-packaging/): custom Christmas gift boxes, velvet pouches, velvet wine bags, paper gift bags and printed mailer boxes with your logo, from 200 pieces
- [Wig packaging](https://elapack.com/custom-wig-packaging/): satin bags and boxes for wigs and hair extensions

- [Packaging case studies](https://elapack.com/case-studies/): three anonymised client projects — velvet GWP pouches for a UK beauty brand, a drawer box and velvet pouch set for a US fine jewelry brand, and a plastic-free magnetic gift box for a European pearl jewelry brand — each with the brief, specification, stage timings and result
